vocabulary.notes: Spanish vocabulary breadth: basic nouns/verbs at A1, idiomatic expressions and regionalisms at B2+, technical/academic vocabulary at C1/C2

grammar.notes: Spanish grammar: present tense at A1, preterite/imperfect at A2, subjunctive mood at B1/B2, compound and complex structures at C1+

reading.notes: Spanish reading comprehension accounting for formal/informal register shifts, regional dialect variations across Spain and Latin America

writing.notes: Spanish writing assessment: orthographic accent marks, coherent paragraph structure, register-appropriate connectors, argument development at B2+

listening.notes: Spanish listening comprehension across peninsular and Latin American varieties, speed and clarity thresholds per CEFR band

speaking.notes: Spanish speaking fluency: pronunciation of rolled 'r', vowel quality, intonation patterns, conversational turn-taking and discourse markers
